rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=30, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=72, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-9: KNOB=val_n 8->30 (single change; CEILING-CONFIRMATION probe -- the MODEL config is FROZEN at iter-8: KEEP pretrain_epochs=72, itnet_k=1, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, unet_c=24, seed=42). PRIOR RESULTS: the epochs lever is SATURATED at k=1 -- iter-6 (ep40)=0.9648, iter-7 (ep56)=0.9608, iter-8 (ep72)=0.9646 are all <=0.9648 and within val_n=8 noise of each other. The campaign record's definitive prior-optimum (ep72/k=1) was supposed to reach 0.9714 but the fresh restart lands at 0.9646. FAILURE MODE: epochs exhausted; the only difference vs the prior run that hit 0.9714 is the METRIC -- the prior used val60, the fresh run uses val_n=8 (noisier, 8 slices). The campaign record already rules OUT every MODEL knob (unet_c=32 / train_n=300 / seed / lr-0.6x ALL worse on the prior run), so there is NO untried model lever with positive evidence. The ONE remaining plausibly-untried axis is the val_n READ itself: at val_n=8 the ep56 0.9608 dip vs ep40/72 ~0.9648 is inside metric noise, so we cannot tell if 0.9646 is the true ceiling or an 8-slice artefact. DEFINITIVE TEST: widen val_n 8->30 (closer to the prior's val60) for a clean, low-variance read of the frozen ep72/k=1 config. HYPOTHESIS: itnet_v2 is at its ~0.965 CONFIG CEILING (NOT the prior 0.9714 -- the fresh restart's k=1 recipe genuinely tops out here); a cleaner val_n=30 read should land ~0.965 +/- a small amount and confirm the ceiling. If it does, the remaining iters (10-20) document this ceiling -- there is no model lever left that the campaign record has not already excluded. WALL GUARD: k=1 is cheap (iter-8 ep72/k=1 ran 270s); val_n 8->30 adds ~30 extra val slices (val_chunk=1) but the train pass is unchanged -> well under the 15-min cap.
